# HBSpro

> AI-powered bilingual (Arabic / English) real-estate cloud for property management, CRM, accounting, and maintenance.

HBSpro (Aqari by HRHBS) is a multi-tenant SaaS built for MENA real-estate agencies. Native RTL, bilingual document generation, and an AI assistant that helps price properties and summarize contracts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Services](/services): Solutions for property management, CRM, accounting, and maintenance.
- [Listings](/listings): Publicly available rental properties.
- [Leasing](/leasing): Rental application and leasing information.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account sign-in and sign-up.
